'''Officer Jenny's Manectric''' (Japanese: '''ジュンサーライボルト''' ''Junsar's Livolt'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by many [[Officer Jenny]]s in the [[Kalos]] [[region]] in {{aniseries|XY}}.

==History==
==={{aniseries|XY}}===
Officer Jenny in the [[Kalos]] region tend to use {{p|Manectric}}, due to {{TP|Officer Jenny|Growlithe}} and {{p|Herdier}} not being native to the [[Kalos]] region.

Officer Jenny's Manectric first appeared in ''[[XY008|Grooming Furfrou!]]'', where it was sent out to battle [[James's Inkay]], but was defeated by his Ink Spray technique. Inkay was eventually defeated by {{AP|Pikachu}}.

Manectric appeared again in ''[[XY012|To Catch a Pokémon Smuggler!]]''; it and [[Officer Jenny]] chased after a smuggler named [[Dolan]], who had stolen a bunch of {{p|Scatterbug}} and {{p|Spewpa}}. One of the Scatterbug fell out of Dolan's car and when Ash took it to a Pokémon Center, Officer Jenny roped Ash, assuming he was working for Dolan. {{an|Clemont}} cleared the whole situation by saying that the group just wanted to help her in stopping Dolan. Officer Jenny, Ash, and his friends then worked together to track the smuggler. As Ash went to an abandoned laboratory and battled Dolan, Officer Jenny and Manectric appeared, battled [[Dolan]] and his {{p|Diggersby}} and arrested the smuggler. 

Manectric appeared in ''[[XY048|A Campus Reunion!]]'', where it inspected the electric systems under the academy alongside Officer Jenny.

Manectric appeared again in ''[[XY054|Facing The Grand Design!]]''. Officer Jenny sent it out to prevent the crystals, that had been created by the scientists who had fallen under {{an|Malamar}}'s hypnotic influence, from distorting the world; it used {{m|Thunder}} to help destroy them. After stopping the three evil Malamar's plan for the second time, Officer Jenny attempted to arrest them, but the antagonistic Malamar escaped by going into the merged crystals.

Manectric reappeared in ''[[XY119|A Full-Strength Battle Surprise!]]'', where it was inspecting a forest area with Officer Jenny and a group of people. They were, however, forced to retreat, due to an attack by large vines mutated by [[Team Flare]]. Manectric began charging electricity in retaliation, but stopped when the bizarre event stopped.

==Personality and characteristics==
Manectric is quite strong and Officer Jenny has great trust in her Manectric. This was best demonstrated when she called it out in ''[[XY054|Facing The Grand Design!]]'' to destroy Malamar's crystals, which it did with just one {{m|Thunder}}. Manectric is also quick in action and caring of its Trainer as is evident when it decided to battle the giant mutated vines attacking its Trainer and the [[Wild Pokémon|wild Pokémon]] on its own without being commanded.
